sources.title: Minutes of the Birchfield Common Committee, 20 October 2026: item 7, Tree planting
passages: The Committee agreed to plant 40 native trees along the eastern boundary this winter.
The cost, £2,400, will be met by a grant from the county's tree fund.

question: Have any committees decided to charge for parking?
about: written by hand for the example site, in the shape real recordings have; not a recording
